subject.title: fix(whatsapp): preserve active connections across runtime reloads

question: Should this runtime fix be merged before the dependent WhatsApp QA repair at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/110754?
rationale: The implementation is narrowly scoped and has targeted coverage, but it changes the intended reload-lifetime owner and the related QA PR is stacked on this branch; that landing-order and ownership decision requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Merge production fix first
options.body: Confirm the stable process-lifetime owner is the intended reload contract, then land this repair and retarget the QA PR afterward.

options.title: Pause for ownership redesign
options.body: Keep the PR open if maintainers want the shared Plugin SDK to own reload-stable context lifetime rather than the WhatsApp plugin.

recommendation.title: Merge production fix first
recommendation.body: Confirm the stable process-lifetime owner is the intended reload contract, then land this repair and retarget the QA PR afterward.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored both the merged runtime-context refactor and the proposed repair, making them the strongest available technical routing candidate.
